RENTAL SCHEDULE
Schedule no. RS-23-0877 to the Master Rental Agreement · standard terms overleaf
1 This rental agreement is entered into between Sample Office Equipment Finance (Pty) Ltd
(sample) (“the Lessor”) and Marula Office Supplies (Pty) Ltd (“the Renter”) on the standard
terms overleaf, which form part of this schedule.
2 · Equipment 1 × A3 colour multifunction copier, model MFC-5055 (sample),
serial no. SN-SAMPLE-0917, with finisher and fax kit
3 · Installation address Unit 4, Oakridge Business Park, 12 Sample Road, Sampleton
4 · Rental period The rental period is 36 months, from 1 November 2023 to 31
October 2026 (“the initial period”).
5 · Monthly rental The monthly rental is R1 980.00, excluding VAT.
6 · Escalation As per clause 6.2 of the standard terms
7 · Payment method Debit order on the 1st of each month
8 · Copy charges Mono R0.19 · colour R1.45 per copy, billed monthly under sep-
arate service agreement SA-23-0877
The Renter confirms that it has read and understood the standard terms overleaf, in particular clauses 4 (owner-
ship), 6 (rental payments), 9 (breach) and 12 (termination), and that the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008 does
not apply to this agreement.
SIGNATURES

STANDARD TERMS OF RENTAL
1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 “Equipment” means the goods described in the
rental schedule, including all parts, accessories
and replacements.
1.2 “Rental” means the monthly amount stated in the
rental schedule, as escalated in terms of clause
6.2.
2. RENTAL
2.1 The Lessor rents the Equipment to the Renter for
the rental period on these terms. Each rental
schedule constitutes a separate agreement.
3. DELIVERY AND ACCEPTANCE
3.1 The Renter selected the Equipment and its sup-
plier and shall sign a delivery and acceptance
certificate on delivery. The Lessor gives no war-
ranty as to the Equipment's fitness for purpose.
4. OWNERSHIP
4.1 Ownership of the Equipment remains with the
Lessor at all times. The Renter shall not sell,
pledge, sublet or remove the Equipment from
the installation address without the Lessor's writ-
ten consent.
4.2 The Renter shall notify the landlord of the install-
ation premises in writing that the Equipment be-
longs to the Lessor, and shall provide the Lessor
with a copy of the notice.
5. USE AND MAINTENANCE
5.1 The Renter shall use the Equipment carefully, in
accordance with the manufacturer's instructions,
and shall have it maintained only by the Lessor's
approved service provider.
6. RENTAL PAYMENTS
6.1 The Rental is payable monthly in advance by
debit order. The Renter's obligation to pay is not
affected by any defect in or failure of the
Equipment.
6.2 The rental escalates by 10% on each anniversary
of the commencement date.
6.3 Overdue amounts bear interest at the maximum
rate permitted by law.
7. INSURANCE AND RISK
7.1 Risk in the Equipment passes to the Renter on
delivery. The Renter shall insure the Equipment
for its full replacement value, noting the Lessor's
interest.
8. CESSION
8.1 The Lessor may cede its rights under this agree-
ment to a financier without notice to the Renter.
The Renter shall not raise against the cessionary
any defence it has against the Lessor.

STANDARD TERMS OF RENTAL (CONTINUED)
9. BREACH
9.1 If the Renter fails to pay any amount on due date
or breaches any other term and fails to remedy it
within 7 (seven) days of written notice, the Lessor
may claim immediate payment of all amounts
owing and the Rental for the unexpired rental
period, or cancel this agreement, repossess the
Equipment and claim damages.
10. CERTIFICATE OF BALANCE
10.1 A certificate signed by any manager of the Lessor
stating the amount owing shall be prima facie
proof of that amount.
11. EARLY SETTLEMENT
11.1 The Renter may settle this agreement before the
end of the initial period by paying the Rental for
the unexpired period plus a settlement fee
quoted by the Lessor.
12. TERMINATION
12.1 The Renter may not terminate during the initial
period except as set out below.
12.2 The Renter may terminate this agreement by giv-
ing three months' written notice before the end
of the initial period.
12.3 If no such notice is given, this agreement contin-
ues month to month on the same terms.
12.4 On termination the Renter shall return the
Equipment, at its cost and in good working or-
der, to an address nominated by the Lessor.
13. CONSUMER PROTECTION
13.1 The Renter warrants that it is a juristic person
whose asset value or annual turnover exceeds
the threshold determined under the Consumer
Protection Act 68 of 2008.
14. GENERAL
14.1 These terms and the rental schedule are the
whole agreement. No variation, relaxation or
cancellation is valid unless in writing and signed
by the Lessor.
14.2 The Renter chooses the installation address as its
domicilium citandi et executandi and consents to
the jurisdiction of the Magistrate's Court.
14.3 The Renter consents to the Lessor obtaining and
sharing its credit information with registered
credit bureaux.
